name: CoreClinic
intent: Occupational-health scaffold: a full app shell (CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar) with a single "Clinic" sidebar entry, and a description-less route header (PageContentHeader) carrying two tabs — a placeholder Overview and a live Worker Fitness list (KPI row, Workers/Visit Logs tabs, DataTable with fitness status, visit counts, and next-due dates) — plus a Settings action that opens a SideMenu sub-surface whose General pane is live (toggle rows + shared FormActionBar).
when: Starting the Clinic / occupational-health product surface that owns its own app shell
A single-section app whose route content is organized by a peer tab set in the header
whenNot: A content page rendered inside an existing app shell -> use a content-only template
A multi-section admin surface where the left nav switches content -> use Admin Panel
Observation and incident management -> use Safety Manager

chooseOver.component: Assembling CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar + PageContentHeader by hand
chooseOver.because: Clinic owns the shell, the header tab scaffold, and the Settings sub-surface so health surfaces plug straight in.
Same shell shape, but scoped to worker health and fitness-for-work rather than observations.

allowedPlacement: route-level clinic / occupational-health surface that owns the full window

extracted: description-less route header scaffold with a Settings action
Settings sub-surface (SideMenu + General toggle rows + FormActionBar save/discard)
KPI row + tabs + DataTable list pattern from CoreWorkforce

notes: Overview tab body is a placeholder pending real clinic analytics
